rounds.story: Igama lihlobene nomsindo wesiShayina wotshani olubiliswa. Isiphuzo safika lapha ngezindlela zokuhweba zasolwandle.
Leli gama lafika nalo mdlalo wokulwa waseJapane. Usho indlela yokusebenzisa amandla ngobuhlakani kunokulwa ngamandla.
Laduma encwadini yaseCzech ngo 1920. Ekuqaleni lalisho umsebenzi ophoqwayo, kwase kusetshenziswa ngomshini osebenzayo.
Livela esiRashiya futhi lihlobene negama lamanzi. Namuhla lisetshenziswa ukubiza lolo hlobo lotshwala.
Igama laqala esiTurki. Libiza ubisi oluvutshelisiwe oludliwa njengokudla noma isidlo esincane.
Lafika lisuka esiPheshiya ngomqondo wezingubo zemilenze. Namuhla lisho izingubo zokulala.
Lisuka emlandweni wesiNtaliyane wokubeka itafula lokushintsha imali emakethe. Lase liba indawo yemali.
Leli gama lasuka esiFulentshini lapho lalisho indawo yokugcina imoto. Kithi lisasho indawo yokupaka nokulungisa.
Lafika kithi ngezindlela zaseNingizimu Afrika, lisuka esiDashi. Libiza izingubo ezigqokwa emilenzeni yomibili.
Umsuka useLatini egameni elisho ibhodi noma ipulangwe. Kamuva laba yigama letafula esilisebenzisa nsuku zonke.
Umsuka waso useGrisi yasendulo. Igama lagcina selibizwa indawo yokufunda lapho izingane nabadala beya khona.
Igama lisuka esiNahuatl saseMexico. Ladabula esiSpanishi ngaphambi kokuba lifike ezilimini eziningi zomhlaba.
